upstream.proposal_mechanics: stored broad/focused sampling and latent decoder/CMA; no target-specific atoms

objective.gauges: Raw slope and oddness encoded; center normalization retained differentiably during fit, frozen in exported state. Gauge resolution is an admission check.
objective.relative_residual: signed sum of four terms squared / sum of four term squares; normalize terms before squaring, no absolute denominator floor
objective.radius_measure: trapezoidal mean in log radius over candidate-specific raw mass .001/.999 quantiles plus two-unit guards
objective.state_selection: last complete measured update, followed by a fresh support/proxy check; no outcome-picked best iterate

support.description: raw mass survey, not reference gauge or fixed canonical radius; require mesh/phase/domain/shell resolution

proposed_search.terminal_initialization: retained coarse raw state from this cold run only

selector.rule: lowest qualified positive common loss, earliest terminal ordinal on exact tie; unresolved/rejected None never ranked
selector.terminal_states: assess every completed fit-eligible retained terminal state within declared cap; record every failed/unvisited/reserved state
selector.coarse_pool: fresh resolved core-aware fitting proxy, never fixed-window public score or reference
